player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''CGogolen''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in September 2001.
description: Very strong deck with a amazing win record.  Went 3-1 at the Montreal DPC with a True Tie time loss to a WYS deck-because Out of play cards in lost pile don't count for a true tie.  Also went 2-1 at DragonCon narrowly losing to Hidden Base.
cards: posted: IAO/secret plans(usually-on rare occassions I start oppressive)
posted: always thinking with your stomach
posted: all power to weapons x3
posted: they're coming in too fast
Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
posted: i can't shake him x2
posted: there'll be hell to pay
Do They Have A Code Clearance?
posted: do they have a code clearance
notes: The published title contains a minced profanity ('Mutha Fu$kin''), so this page is titled Chris Gogolen DS; the post's title is kept below as published.

Starting cards as posted: Endor Operations, Endor, Endor: Bunker, Endor: Landing Platform, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Combat Response and Planetary Subjugation; these count toward the 60. The author notes he 'on rare occasions' starts Oppressive Enforcement (posted under Effects) instead of IAO/Secret Plans.
Endor system and sites, Naboo, and 'coruscant(coruscant set)' dested to their Dark pages (Coruscant (Dark) (Coruscant) for the Coruscant-set system).
Posted 'planetary' (a starting effect pulled by Prepared Defenses) dested Planetary Subjugation; 'IAO/secret plans' dested Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans (missed by the machine draft).

Posted 'short range/watch your back' dested Short Range Fighters & Watch Your Back!; 'dark manuever/tallon roll' Dark Maneuvers & Tallon Roll; 'ghhk/those rebels' Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us.

Posted 'epp vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'baron' Baron Soontir Fel; 'capt jonus' Captain Jonus; 'cmd merrejk' Commander Merrejk; 'darth maul(tat)' Darth Maul (Tatooine); 'major phennir' Major Turr Phennir; 'dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'sfs cannon' SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons; 'zuckuss in MH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.
The 'Admiral Order' section header was mis-parsed by the machine draft as a card and is dropped; Fighter Cover is the one Admiral's Order.
The description claims 3-1 at the Montreal DPC and 2-1 at DragonCon (2001); no finish is given and the wiki has no 2001 DragonCon event page, so the deck is listed as a general deck.
